development_checkout.resolution: On the operator machine identify the existing checkout; verify pwd -P, git remote -v, git rev-parse HEAD, git status --short; never create a second mutable clone as a shortcut

production_use_path.resolution: Identify any installed product directory or container volume and compare to development checkout before updates

temporary_worktree_root.resolution: Select only after verifying the canonical development checkout and preserving existing dirty/unique work

operator_entrypoint.resolution: Inspect bound services and actual browser reachability; historical screenshot alone does not prove current launch

no_deployment_profile_reason: No other physical machine, production environment, or deployed use path has been established in provider evidence
forbidden_assumptions: historical localhost screenshot is a live runtime
